node: HVDC transformer winding components, continuously transposed conductors, and qualified grid-OEM inputs
summary: This Layer 1B pass did not identify a clean US-listed pure-play continuously transposed conductor or transformer winding-wire supplier comparable to the India KSH International seed. The US-listed universe appears to map more naturally to: 1) reference OEMs that build HVDC transformers and grid systems, 2) larger qualified utility-component suppliers such as bushings, connectors, insulators, arresters and substation hardware, and 3) underfollowed adjacent transmission hardware suppliers whose demand may move ahead of grid construction. The strongest underfollowed candidate from this pass is PLPC, but its relation is adjacent transmission hardware rather than transformer winding inputs. Direct CTC exposure remains a coverage gap requiring verification via customer/OEM supplier lists, PGCIL-equivalent qualification databases, transformer OEM procurement disclosures, and private-company mapping.
